notes: Summary: Aurora Insight runs a mid-market analytics SaaS (in-product assistants + search). Completed a 6-week Hosted API trial; now leaning toward move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost. Key ask is a concrete Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic forecast and pricing scenarios. Trial metrics: avg QPS ~4, typical weekday peak 10-12 QPS, observed single-day stress peak 16 QPS during marketing surge. Concurrency: baseline 3-6, peak concurrency observed 18 during rerank-heavy batch. Token mix observed during trial: chat/support ~65% of calls (median tokens/request ~520 total), embeddings index/update workload ~20% (avg 1.2k tokens per request when indexing), reranking ~15% (short prompts but high re-rank fan-out). Estimated avg token per request across workloads ~640. Latency goals: chat p50 <200ms, p95 <600ms; embeddings throughput target 25-50 reqs/sec for bulk indexing jobs (can be scheduled). Cost sensitivity: high — finance prefers committed monthly rate with clear vGPU/hr equivalent and fallback to hosted for burst. Security: must be deployed into VPC with customer-managed KMS; SOC2 compliance and audit logging required, retention policy 13 months. Quote from CTO: "We need predictable per-token economics and an easy path to autoscale for spikes — cannot have chat degrading during launches." POC asks for: 1) two Dedicated sizing scenarios (steady-state + 3x peak burst), 2) expected QPS -> vGPU mapping and concurrency guidance, 3) cost delta vs Hosted on 12-month commit, 4) migration checklist (model pinning, rollout, KV cache warm-up). Links: pricing deck and security FAQ in drive. Next tactical: schedule 90m sizing workshop w/ infra (Mar 4 week) to finalize traffic forecast (AE: Maya; SE: Liam; Eng lead: Priya R.).
technical_forecast_notes: Measured trial numbers: avg QPS 4, 95th QPS 12, burst event up to 16; avg tokens/request ~640; request distribution: 70% short (<512 tokens), 25% medium (512-2048), 5% long (>2048). Expected 6-month growth: 2.5x active users -> project steady-state QPS ~10, planned peak headroom 25 QPS. Concurrency planning: aim for capacity to handle sustained 20 concurrent chat streams with p95 <600ms. Approx token/sec compute estimate: steady-state 10 QPS * 640 tokens = 6.4k tokens/sec; peak 25 QPS * 640 = 16k tokens/sec. Requested Redwood Dedicated options: 1x A100-style unit for baseline + burst autoscale to 2-3 units, or 4x A10 for cost-optimized steady capacity; ask SE to provide expected tokens/sec per GPU and batching config assumed. SE asked to include estimated KV cache hit rate assumptions (20-40%) and savings.
